families.referenceCue: Mid-value olive and hillside foliage bridging the terraced slopes and stone walls.
Bright sunlit yellow-green tree crowns and grassy terrace slope in the lower-center foreground.
Dark vertical cypress spires, deep tree trunks, and dark architectural eaves and cast shadows in the upper village.
Sunlit warm limestone house facades, stone terrace walls, and terracotta roofs clustered on the hillside.
Deep olive-green and cool-umber shadow masses beneath the tree canopy and across the upper-left and central hillside.
Warm sunlit ochre-green foliage and terraced hillside slopes across the left and lower-left middle ground.
